page.overview:
Who is Antarctosaurus?

is an extinct genus of titanosaurian [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sauropoda sauropod] dinosaur that lived in South America during the Late Cretaceous period. Its name doesn't mean it was found on the frozen continent Antarctica, but rather being found in the south.

Antarctosaurus is one of the largest of the South American long-necked dinosaurs. Some of the fossil bones of this dinosaur led scientists to believe that it could have grown as big as 130 feet (40 m) long! This family also includes Argentinosaurus, another South American giant.

Placing Antarctosaurus into the titanosaur family has come into question based on some recent studies. A specimen nearly twice the size of the type specimen was originally assigned a separate species but is now considered a very large individual of the same species.

Antarctosaurus was featured in the Jurassic Park Institute now available to browse on Dinopedia.
